label: D1 after an unrewarded trial (fades late in the episode)
explanation: Fires only at D1 (never at GO or D2), and essentially only when the reward input shows the previous trial was unrewarded (prev_reward==0 covers 99.95% of activations; it almost never fires after a reward). The rate falls over the episode: it fires on about 40% of unrewarded D1s overall, is roughly flat through trial ~60, declines over trials 70-89, and is silent at trials 90-99. Adding ep_trial<80 raises dev F1 from 0.57 to 0.65 while keeping 99% of mass recall. Within unrewarded D1s, activation is more frequent and larger when the agent is about to favour a1 (choice logit > 0 holds 87% of mass at 71% recall; upcoming action a1 holds 75% of mass) and when S1 is the hidden good state (good==1: 72% of mass). This is an asymmetry for one action, not a stay/switch signal. Those conditions give only small F1 gains (0.65 to 0.69), so I recorded the simpler observed-only predicate. No future variables are used. It does not fire after rewarded trials, at GO or D2, or in the last ~10 trials of an episode.
